name: One Hundred Days With an Angel
source:
This is a visual novel about a guy named Cecil who finds a boy with wings in an alley at night. He says he is his guardian angel. Could it be true? Play to find out!

[From [url=https://octosqu1d.itch.io/one-hundred-days-with-an-angel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说讲述塞西尔在夜晚的小巷里发现一个长着翅膀的男孩。男孩说自己是他的守护天使。这是真的吗？游玩本作即可揭晓！

[来源：[url=https://octosqu1d.itch.io/one-hundred-days-with-an-angel]itch.io[/url]]
